card.name: Linking words in pregnancy and neonatal risk text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (which, of, in, to, the, appropriate) that sit just before a noun phrase in medical text, especially pregnancy, newborn and opioid-withdrawal warnings.

modes.label: Pregnancy advice wording
modes.description: Linking word right after 'advise pregnant women...' or 'ensure that' before the named risk or treatment.
modes.example: Advise pregnant women using opioids for a prolonged period<< of>> the risk of neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome

modes.label: Definition of a treatment or trial
modes.description: A relative or linking word introducing an explanation of a therapy or study.
modes.example: clinical trials (research studies in<< which>> people volunteer to take part)

card.writes: The promoted tokens are code-like words about iteration, which has little to do with the text, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in sentences about pregnancy, newborn risks and how a treatment works.
